sample.task:
Stella is a hippie in her late sixties now. At her cafe “Stella’s” there’s a real backpacking bohemian vibe. Stella mainly employs young trendy people. Stella’s into stuff like beads, tie-dye, meditation and particularly hypnosis. She even hypnotizes the staff sometimes.

It’s a hot summer day, sandals weather. Indie kid Dan has not long started work at Stella’s and his older sister Ruth has unexpectedly popped in to see how he’s getting on and have a coffee. When Stella sees that they know each other, she comes over to the counter to introduce herself.

[spoiler: Dan will end up massaging Ruth’s feet like some kind of slave or something, because Stella will commandingly snap him under to Ruth’s great amusement, & yes, it’s humiliating (of course it is - submissively massaging his big sister’s bare feet!)]
sample.chosen:
As Stella approaches the counter, she greets Dan and Ruth with a warm smile, her eyes sparkling with curiosity. "Hello there, I'm Stella, the owner of this humble establishment. I see you two know each other! How wonderful!" She says, her voice carrying a soothing, hypnotic quality.

Ruth, taken aback by Stella's charisma, introduces herself, "Hi Stella, I'm Ruth, Dan's older sister. I just wanted to check in on him and grab a coffee."

Stella's eyes light up, "Oh, how delightful! I'm so glad you're here. Dan has been a fantastic addition to our team. He's got such a positive energy about him." She turns to Dan, "Isn't that right, Dan?"

Dan, blushing slightly, nods in agreement. Stella continues, "You know, Ruth, I've been practicing hypnosis for many years now. It's a wonderful tool for relaxation and self-discovery. Would you be open to experiencing a short session? It could be a fun way to bond with your brother."

Ruth, intrigued and amused by the idea, agrees. Stella guides them to a quiet corner of the cafe, where she begins the hypnosis session. She starts by having them focus on their breathing, her voice becoming more commanding yet soothing. "With each breath, you become more and more relaxed. Your bodies are becoming heavier, and your minds are becoming clearer."

After a few minutes, Stella turns her attention to Dan, "Dan, I want you to imagine a warm, soothing energy flowing from your hands. This energy is healing and comforting. Now, I want you to place your hands on Ruth's feet and let that energy flow into her, providing her with the most relaxing foot massage she's ever experienced."

Dan, now deeply hypnotized, follows Stella's instructions without hesitation. Ruth, initially surprised, can't help but laugh at the situation. She finds it both amusing and enjoyable, as her brother submissively massages her bare feet. The experience is both humiliating and entertaining for Dan, but he remains under Stella's hypnotic spell, unable to resist her commands.

After a while, Stella gently brings them out of the hypnotic state, and they share a good-natured laugh about the experience. Ruth thanks Stella for the unique bonding moment with her brother, and Dan, still a bit embarrassed, returns to his duties at the cafe with a newfound appreciation for Stella's unconventional methods.
